source: Adapted cross-reference, September 2026: Miami New Times, 'Best Ultra Music Festival Performances of All Time' (Jose D. Duran, 25 March 2026), found by web search for 'best Ultra Music Festival sets of all time'; Wikipedia (Ultra Music Festival; Ultra Europe) for the bills by year; view counts read from YouTube search data on 13 September 2026. UMF TV's own most-viewed uploads are aftermovies (Relive Ultra Miami 2012, 38 million), so the full sets come from the artists' own channels. Every player oEmbed-checked 13 September 2026. This site's catalogue (source 6 of FIGURES.md) was not used as a criterion.

required_records.title: Skrillex
required_records.why: the most-watched Ultra set found, 94.3 million views on his own channel (2026-09-13); on Miami New Times' list of Ultra's best performances

required_records.title: Hardwell
required_records.set: Hardwell live at Ultra Music Festival 2013 - FULL HD Broadcast by UMF.TV
required_records.why: 35.7 million views on his own channel (2026-09-13); on Miami New Times' list of Ultra's best performances

required_records.title: Pendulum
required_records.set: Pendulum / Knife Party Headline Set Ultra, 2016
required_records.why: closed Ultra 2016 (Miami New Times); the drum and bass evidence in the music section; 2.4 million views on Pendulum's own channel (pendulumlive, @pendulum)

known_gaps.title: Swedish House Mafia, 2018 reunion
known_gaps.why: the full 2018 set is only on fan channels (CREME FRENCH, 2.1 million), which are rejected; Swedish House Mafia's own channel carries their Ultra 2023 (3.8 million) and 2026 (1.8 million) sets, not 2018

known_gaps.title: Martin Garrix, 2015
known_gaps.why: 38.8 million views on his channel, second only to Skrillex; not on the best-performances list read, so named in the text and not embedded

known_gaps.title: Jack Ü closing, 2015
known_gaps.why: UMF TV's most-viewed set upload (10.2 million), but a 20-minute closing segment rather than a full set; named, not embedded

known_gaps.title: LTJ Bukem (1999), Andy C (2001)
known_gaps.why: on the first Ultra bill and at the first Bayfront Park edition (Miami New Times); no recordings on an official channel found
